info.text:
AI and chip stocks lost over $1 trillion in four days.
20 of the world's most valuable AI and chip stocks shed $1T+ from Oct 12-15, 2026 (CNBC).
Nvidia fell 5.3%, about $291 billion in value.
The SOXX chip fund fell 8 sessions in a row through Oct 15, down about 12.6% from its Oct 2 close.
Reported worries: rate-hike fears after hot inflation data, AI debt, CoreWeave, memory chip competition.
Sources: CNBC, Seeking Alpha.
News and education, not financial advice.
